example.why_en: Chat is a le word: le chat.

en.title: Le, la or l’?
en.teach: Every French noun is a le word or a la word, so learn the word with it: le chat, la maison. Before a vowel or a silent h, le and la become l’: l’arbre, l’hôpital.
